$comment: Hellboard configuration (Firmware/libs/config.py). Stratagems are referenced by their id in doc/stratagems.json. fixed: buttons 1_1 and 1_2; loadout: buttons 2_1 to 2_4; multiFunction: list of button 1_3, cycled with 1_4. modifierKey: HID usage id of the stratagem key (6 = C). menuDelayMs / keyPressMs / keyReleaseMs: key timings; screenSaverSeconds: display off after this time without activity (0 = off); scrollText: 'off', 'long' (names longer than a line scroll back and forth) or 'loop' (they run continuously). saved.json on the board ('Set as default' in the Companion) overrides this file.
